fold_stability.note: Discovery signal does not persist into validation/final folds.

conclusion: Insufficient evidence for robust high-low dispersion premium OOS; discovery effect not replicated. Flag all folds with n<5 per state before drawing conclusions.

inference_fix_applied.note: Degenerate point-estimate CIs replaced with block-bootstrap intervals. High/low state CIs now proper intervals; high-low diff CI is null because high/low states never share a formation date (paired inference not computable).
